new_indicators.name: Payment out of a CBI development fund (line item)
new_indicators.definition: One payment out of a citizenship-by-investment development fund (Antigua's National Development Fund), as listed line by line by the programme (one row per line). Period is the payment date (day precision); breakdown item=p<page>-l<line>. Where a list prints the same payment in two currencies (US$ and its EC$/XCD equivalent), each is a row with its own unit. Details and payee in notes. Money.
new_indicators.notes: Proposed by extract-cbi-atg-rest-2026-10-10 for the Antigua CIU six-monthly reports (2015 H2 Appendix VII, 2016 H2 Appendix IX). Line-item companion of cbi_fund_payments category=ndf (totals). Amounts in the lists' 'Transfers to Consolidated Fund in EC$' column are recorded as cbi_transfers_to_government category=consolidated_fund with the same item=.

new_indicators.name: Payment out of a CBI-financed escrow fund (line item)
new_indicators.definition: One payment out of an escrow fund financed by a citizenship-by-investment programme (Antigua's Renewable Energy Escrow Fund, paying PV Energy), as listed line by line (one row per line). Period is the payment date; breakdown item=p<page>-l<line>. Money.
new_indicators.notes: Proposed by extract-cbi-atg-rest-2026-10-10 for the Antigua CIU 2016 H2 report, Appendix VIII. Line-item companion of cbi_fund_payments category=renewable_energy_escrow. Could be merged with ndf_disbursement under a general fund line-item indicator with category=.

new_indicators.name: Credit to a CBI-financed escrow fund (line item)
new_indicators.definition: One credit (deposit) to an escrow fund financed by a citizenship-by-investment programme (Antigua's Renewable Energy Escrow Fund), as listed line by line. Period is the credit date; breakdown item=p<page>-l<line>. Money.
new_indicators.notes: Proposed by extract-cbi-atg-rest-2026-10-10 for the Antigua CIU 2016 H2 report, Appendix VIII. Line-item companion of cbi_fund_credits category=renewable_energy_escrow.

new_indicators.name: Total purchase prices listed for an approved programme project
new_indicators.definition: The 'Total Purchase Prices' a programme lists against each approved real-estate project or business investment (breakdown route= and item=<project>), as printed. The source does not define them; most likely the total price of qualifying purchases by applicants in the project in the period. Money.
new_indicators.notes: Proposed by extract-cbi-atg-rest-2026-10-10 for the Antigua CIU 2015 H2 report, Appendix VIII (overview). Kept separate from cbi_real_estate_inflows because the measure is not stated.
